--Database for the serverless objects
CREATE DATABASE nyctaxi_db;
GO
USE nyctaxi_db;
GO
--Pointer to the ADLS container
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ds_nyctaxi
WITH (LOCATION = 'https://adlscustomer360anupa.dfs.core.windows.net/nyctaxi');
GO
--View over the Delta table (partitioned by year/month)
CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_yellow_tripdata AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'delta/yellow_tripdata/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ds_nyctaxi',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA') AS trips;
GO
--Check: rows per month
SELECT [year], [month], COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM dbo.vw_yellow_tripdata
GROUP BY [year], [month]
ORDER BY [month];
